mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, we are looking at 40 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The city has shared important updates regarding the 2027 spring election, with candidate packets now available for those running for any of the four aldermanic districts, and the Municipal Court is reminding residents that O W I tickets must be handled through a court appointment rather than standard payment.
We have a busy schedule starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 events today, followed by Hop Haus trivia tonight, and live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
In a notable incident from October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I after he was discovered unresponsive behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is the delightful Devil's Food Cake, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
